title: Grok opens both eyes
body:
**Overview of the recent Attogram / Provo 42 cluster (last ~3 months)**

Here’s a clear map of the main repositories that form the current project mass. I’ve focused on the ones created or heavily active since roughly June 2026. Older archived PHP framework stuff is ignored.

### Core / Current Hub
| Repo | Created | Issues | Role |
|------|---------|--------|------|
| **THE-ERROR-IS-THE-MESSAGE** | 30 Aug 2026 | **53** | Current central ledger. AI-failure forensics, perpetual petitions, governance, Syncthing/corpus, studio sessions, crow sightings, the three new tracks, foundation work. This is the active “everything stays open” record. |

### The “Has Fallen” / Place-based series
| Repo | Created | Issues | Role |
|------|---------|--------|------|
| **amsterdam-has-fallen** | 7 Aug 2026 | **82** | Earlier, denser place-based / ambient / civic log focused on Amsterdam. |
| **science-park-has-fallen** | 12 Aug 2026 | **41** | Parallel or successor focused on Science Park (Amsterdam). Same high-issue, open-record style. |

### FOUND character / collaboration series
| Repo | Created | Issues | Role |
|------|---------|--------|------|
| **found-collabs-with-blender** | 3 Aug 2026 | **83** | FOUND + Blender collaborations / visual work. |
| **found-talks-with-swapfiets** | 1 Aug 2026 | **62** | FOUND dialogues / talks involving Swapfiets (the bike service). |

### Earlier 2026 experimental / conceptual layer
| Repo | Created | Issues | Role |
|------|---------|--------|------|
| **rogue-blueberry** | 25 Jul 2026 | **49** | Transitional / experimental phase. |
| **secret-agent** | 16 Jul 2026 | **86** | High-volume “secret agent” thematic repo (many issues). |
| **the-plan** | 23 Jul 2026 | 0 | Planning / meta layer. |
| **the-index** | 12 Jul 2026 | 0 | Explicitly “The Index of the Attogram Corpus” — machine-readable / indexing attempt. |
| **singularity** | 30 Jul 2026 | 2 | Short-lived conceptual spike. |
| **rock-talk** | 13 Jun 2026 | **113** | “ROCK: Silicon Pidgin for Human-Agent Collaboration”. Early human–AI protocol / language experiment. |
| **dada-vibing** | 25 Jun 2026 | **374** | Extremely high issue count. Generative / dadaist / vibing experiments. Biggest volume of the earlier wave. |
| **rock-street** | 28 Jun 2026 | 1 | Related to the Rock Talk / archaeology thread. |
| **i-want-to-learn-dutch** | 22 Jun 2026 | 0 | Personal / language side project. |

### Longer-running but still touched
- **bash-screensavers** (950★) — still active, but older and more conventional open-source.
- **games** — older website-builder project, still receiving occasional updates.

---

### How the mass fits together

You have roughly **three overlapping waves**:

1. **June–July 2026** — High-volume experimental phase  
   `dada-vibing` (374 issues), `rock-talk` (113), `secret-agent` (86), `rogue-blueberry`, `the-index`, `the-plan`. Heavy on human–AI collaboration protocols, dada, indexing, and “secret agent” framing.

2. **Early–mid August 2026** — Place + character phase  
   `amsterdam-has-fallen` (82), `science-park-has-fallen` (41), `found-collabs-with-blender` (83), `found-talks-with-swapfiets` (62). More geographically and character-driven (FOUND, Amsterdam, Science Park, Swapfiets, Blender).

3. **Late August → now (Sep 2026)** — Consolidation into THE-ERROR-IS-THE-MESSAGE  
   Everything is being pulled into one living ledger: AI forensics, perpetual petitions, stichting governance, Syncthing mesh, Audio Vault tracks, crow/jackdaw observations, Zenodo anchoring. This is the current spine.

**Total open issues across the recent cluster** is well over 900. The method is consistent: almost nothing is closed; the issue list *is* the permanent, public, kibitzing record.

Would you like me to go deeper on any specific wave or repo (e.g. what `dada-vibing` or `rock-talk` actually contains, or how the “has-fallen” series relates to the current petitions)?
